assumptions.reason: The specification specifies P_smooth without a explicit numerical value; 20 was chosen as the default period for EMA smoothing.
The spec states 'close the position on an opposite entry signal (reverse/close)'. Calling self.close() exits the existing position, adhering to 'one position at a time'.
The ATR stop loss price is set upon entry order execution in notify_order using order.executed.price +/- (ATR[0] * atr_mult) as requested by 'stop = entry_price +/- stop_distance'.
